title: [E-Document Formats][OIOUBL] Migrate NAV PR 247162 into BCApps
summary: New OIOUBL e-document format reader for Denmark that parses OIOUBL XML invoices and credit notes into purchase staging tables, enabling structured e-document import using vendor VAT registration, GLN, or PEPPOL identifiers.
key_points: New E-Document OIOUBL Handler codeunit implements IStructuredFormatReader.ReadIntoDraft for OIOUBL Invoice and CreditNote XML
Vendor lookup by VAT registration number, GLN, or PEPPOL participant ID
Enum extension registers the handler on E-Doc. Read into Draft
Uses the public E-Document PEPPOL Utility instead of NAV's EDocument XML Helper
New OIOUBL test app with structured tests; E-Document Core grants it internalsVisibleTo
quote: Migrates internal NAV PR 247162 (OIOUBL structured E-Document reader) into BCApps
